minutes.headline: Committee agreed to seek a design-team scope funded by ARPA, with Ritter first; scope draft due at the next meeting.
minutes.summary: The Municipal Building Design Committee discussed the scope of work for a design professional to advance the hybrid concept covering four buildings, and how to phase the work. Members debated whether to repair the TC Passios roof first, and the chair raised the schools' Turkey Hill needs. No substantive vote was taken beyond adjournment; the chair will draft a scope from the prior RFP for the next meeting.

public_comment.topic: A speaker (appears to be Greg Roy, though not stated) said they look forward to restarting the process and hope the professional scope can be kept limited and inexpensive.

votes.motion: Move to adjourn, by roll call
votes.outcome: passed; roll call of Gray, Christina, David, Roy, Allison and chair all aye

budget_items.topic: ARPA request for professional design support
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said a placeholder ARPA request is before the select board to obtain professional help moving the concept forward.

budget_items.topic: Earlier cost estimates per square foot
budget_items.what_was_said: A member recalled applying a per-square-foot cost to project square footages and presenting those numbers to the select board.
The chair said the roof work is estimated to be over a million dollars and the select board wants it part of a bigger plan. Another member said it is an easy sell compared with replacement cost.
The chair said the school committee gave a rough estimate to extend Turkey Hill by about ten years, and later said his own thinking was a much smaller figure for short-term fixes.

budget_items.topic: Phase three TC Passios renovation estimate
budget_items.what_was_said: A member cited the committee's estimate to renovate TC Passios.
A member said serious funding will likely need an override vote and visuals showing voters what they would get.
The chair said ARPA money must be committed by the end of next year and spent by 2026, and does not directly hit the local tax base.

budget_items.topic: Solar on old town dump as revenue
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair described a possible solar project on town property as a revenue source to offset building costs.

decisions.decision: Chair will work with Heather to modify the prior RFP scope, include alternates for services the committee might supply itself, and bring it to the next meeting.
Members appeared to agree an ARPA request should be directed at renderings and more granular cost of the early phases.
General leaning that Ritter be phase one with a roof fix at TC Passios; no formal decision recorded.

what_happened.line: The committee took no vote beyond adjournment, but leaned toward Ritter as the first phase, paired with a roof repair at TC Passios; no formal decision was recorded.
A placeholder request for ARPA funds for professional design help is before the select board; members appeared to agree it should target renderings and more detailed early-phase costs.
The chair will work with Heather to adapt the prior RFP scope, with alternates for services the committee might supply itself, and bring it to the next meeting.
Members said the TC Passios roof work is expensive and the select board wants it folded into a bigger plan; one member said serious funding will likely need an override vote.
The next meeting was set for September 18.

why_it_matters: The committee is working out how to stage the replacement or repair of four town buildings, and any large share of the cost would probably come to voters as an override or town meeting question.
ARPA money is described as coming from outside the local tax base, but it has deadlines for commitment and spending, which sets the pace for how soon design work can start.
